79291-the-mysterious-locket.title: The Mysterious Locket
79291-the-mysterious-locket.creator: Unknown
79291-the-mysterious-locket.description: A public-domain book from Project Gutenberg. The red glow from a steadily burning fire of culm and clay lighted up the interior, revealing the shelves hollowed in the wall full of crockery, the wooden settle by the hearth, and the two cupboard-beds which stood like huge chests in the centre, dividing the room as by a partition.

arxiv-1801-04196.title: Detection of collective optic excitations in molten NaI
arxiv-1801-04196.creator: S. Hosokawa ? , ?, M. Inui ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, T. Bryk ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, I. Mryglod ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, W.-C. Pilgrim ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, Y. Kajihara ? {}^{\textsf{\footnotesize{\mbox{?}}}}, K. Matsuda ? {}^{\texts
arxiv-1801-04196.description: Abstract High-resolution inelastic x-ray scattering measurements were carried out on molten NaI near the melting point at 680 ∘ C at SPring-8. Small and damped indications of longitudinal optic excitation modes were observed on the tails of the longitudinal acoustic modes at small momentum transfers, Q ∼ 5 Q\sim 5 nm -1 .

arxiv-1808-06638.title: Supervised Kernel PCA For Longitudinal Data
arxiv-1808-06638.creator: Patrick Staples, Min Ouyang, Robert F. Dougherty, Gregory A. Ryslik, Paul Dagum
arxiv-1808-06638.description: Abstract In statistical learning, high covariate dimensionality poses challenges for robust prediction and inference. To address this challenge, supervised dimension reduction is often performed, where dependence on the outcome is maximized for a selected covariate subspace with smaller dimensionality. Prevalent dimension reduction techniques assume data are i.i.d.

arxiv-2104-03123.title: Partially-Connected Differentiable Architecture Search for Deepfake and Spoofing Detection
arxiv-2104-03123.creator: Wanying Ge, Michele Panariello, Jose Patino, Massimiliano Todisco, Nicholas Evans
arxiv-2104-03123.description: Abstract This paper reports the first successful application of a differentiable architecture search (DARTS) approach to the deepfake and spoofing detection problems. An example of neural architecture search, DARTS operates upon a continuous, differentiable search space which enables both the architecture and parameters to be optimised via gradient descent.

arxiv-2106-14697.title: Image of the thin accretion disk around compact objects in the Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity
arxiv-2106-14697.creator: Galin Gyulchev, Petya Nedkova, Tsvetan Vetsov, Stoytcho Yazadjiev
arxiv-2106-14697.description: Abstract We study the optical appearance of a thin accretion disk around compact objects within the Einstein-Gauss-Bonnet gravity. Considering static spherically symmetric black holes and naked singularities we search for characteristic signatures which can arise in the observable images due to the modification of general relativity.

arxiv-2304-00182.title: Statistical Analysis of Chen Distribution Under Improved Adaptive Type-II Progressive Censoring
arxiv-2304-00182.creator: Li Zhang🖂 İD College of Mathematics and Statistics Northwest Normal University, Lanzhou 730070, China
arxiv-2304-00182.description: Abstract This paper takes into account the estimation for the two unknown parameters of the Chen distribution with bathtub-shape hazard rate function under the improved adaptive Type-II progressive censored data. Maximum likelihood estimation for two parameters are proposed and the approximate confidence intervals are established using the asymptotic normality.

arxiv-2304-09736.title: Khuri-Treiman analysis of 𝑱 / 𝝍 → 𝝅 + ​ 𝝅 − ​ 𝝅 𝟎 J/\psi\to\pi^{+}\pi^{-}\pi^{0}

We find that the BESIII experimental di-pion mass distribution in the ρ ⁡ ( 770 ) \rho(770) -region is well reproduced with a once-subtracted P P -wave amplitude.

arxiv-2308-09732.title: Baird Counterexample is Solved: with an example of How to Debug a Two-time-scale Algorithm
arxiv-2308-09732.creator: Hengshuai Yao
arxiv-2308-09732.description: Abstract Baird counterexample was proposed by Leemon Baird in 1995, first used to show that the Temporal Difference (TD(0)) algorithm diverges on this example. Since then, it is often used to test off-policy learning algorithms. Gradient TD algorithms solved the divergence issue of TD on Baird counterexample.

arxiv-2506-13740.title: Kolmogorov-Arnold Network for Gene Regulatory Network Inference
arxiv-2506-13740.creator: Tsz Pan Tong, Aoran Wang, George Panagopoulos, Jun Pang
arxiv-2506-13740.description: Abstract Gene regulation is central to understanding cellular processes and development, potentially leading to the discovery of new treatments for diseases and personalized medicine. Inferring gene regulatory networks (GRNs) from single-cell RNA sequencing (scRNA-seq) data presents significant challenges due to its high dimensionality and complexity.

arxiv-2507-12184.description: Abstract . We analyze from a geometric perspective the Hamiltonian formulation of a recent modification of the Husain-Kuchař model where, while preserving the connection as a dynamical variable, the other field is restricted to be the exterior covariant derivative of a Lie algebra-valued function.

arxiv-2510-03418.title: LegalWiz: A Multi-Agent Generation Framework for Contradiction Detection in Legal Documents
arxiv-2510-03418.creator: Ananya Mantravadi, Shivali Dalmia, Abhishek Mukherji, Nand Dave, Anudha Mittal, Olga Pospelova
arxiv-2510-03418.description: Abstract Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) integrates large language models (LLMs) with external sources, but unresolved contradictions in retrieved evidence often lead to hallucinations and legally unsound outputs. Benchmarks currently used for contradiction detection lack domain realism, cover only limited conflict types, and rarely extend beyond single-sentence pairs, making them unsuitable for legal applications.

Acne vulgaris afflicts more than fifty million people in the United State and the severity of this disorder is associated with the immune response to Propionibacterium acnes (P. acnes) . Systemic therapies for acne target P. acnes using antibiotics, or target the follicle with re

pmc-11488207.title: Presence of Plasmodium falciparum strains with artemisinin-resistant K13 mutation C469Y in Busia County, Western Kenya
pmc-11488207.creator: Mark Makau, Bernard N Kanoi, Calvin Mgawe, Michael Maina, Mimie Bitshi, Edwin K Too, Taeko K Naruse, Hussein M Abkallo, Harrison Waweru, Ferdinand Adung’o, Osamu Kaneko, Jesse Gitaka
pmc-11488207.description: Malaria remains a key health and economic problem, particularly in sub-Saharan Africa. The emergence of artemisinin drug resistance (ART-R) parasite strains poses a serious threat to the control and elimination of this scourge. This is because artemisinin-based combination therapies (ACTs) remain the first-line treatment in the majority of malaria-endemic regions in Sub-Saharan Africa.

pmc-11602885.creator: Luca Badolato, Francesco C Billari, Aart C Liefbroer

pmc-12468897.title: NRGAMTE: Neurophysiological Residual Gated Attention Multimodal Transformer Encoder for Sleep Disorder Detection
pmc-12468897.creator: Jayapoorani Subramaniam, Aruna Mogarala Guruvaya, Anupama Vijaykumar, Puttamadappa Chaluve Gowda
pmc-12468897.description: Background/Objective: Sleep is significant for human mental and physical health. Sleep disorders represent a crucial risk to human health, and a large portion of the world population suffers from them. The efficient identification of sleep disorders is significant for effective treatment.

pmc-12508265.title: Miliary TB Without Microbiological Confirmation in a Post‐Menopausal Female: A Case From a High‐Burden Region
pmc-12508265.creator: Jabir Ahamad Miya, Shishir Bhandari, Pukar Adhikari
pmc-12508265.description: Miliary tuberculosis (TB) presents significant diagnostic challenges in resource‐limited, high‐burden regions when microbiological confirmation is unattainable. We describe a 65‐year‐old post‐menopausal Nepalese woman with prolonged fever, anemia, and constitutional symptoms. Initial chest radiography was inconclusive, but contrast‐enhanced computed tomography (CECT) revealed diffuse miliary nodules, calcified lymphadenopathy, and pleural effusion.

pmc-12605223.title: International cost-effectiveness analysis in osimertinib after chemoradiotherapy in stage III EGFR-mutated non-small cell lung cancer
pmc-12605223.creator: Diya Tang, Xi Zou, Chaochao Wei, Xiaoyu Zhang
pmc-12605223.description: BackgroundThe international Phase 3 LAURA trial (NCT03521154) demonstrated that the use of osimertinib following chemoradiotherapy markedly improved survival outcomes in unresectable stage III NSCLC with epidermal growth factor receptor (EGFR) mutations. Considering the high cost of targeted therapy, the popularization of osimertinib in clinical practice should be considered comprehensively in terms of cost and efficacy.

pmc-13077863.title: Impairment of brain short association fibers across clinical stages in amyotrophic lateral sclerosis: a new biomarker mirroring disease progression
pmc-13077863.creator: Nao-Xin Huang, Zi-Wei Cai, Shao-Peng Zhuang, Hong-Yu Lin, Sheng Chen, Zhang-Yu Zou, Ye Wu, Hua-Jun Chen
pmc-13077863.description: BackgroundA quantitative biomarker for clinical staging is essential for amyotrophic lateral sclerosis (ALS) stratification. This study evaluated microstructural impairment in brain short association fibers (SAFs) across ALS stages via neurite orientation dispersion and density imaging (NODDI) and assessed correlations with disease severity.MethodsDiffusion-weighted imaging data were collected from 87 ALS patients (categorized into four groups King's stages) and 37 healthy controls.

pmc-13165276.title: Evaluation of Growth Differentiation Factor 15 as an Early Biomarker of Anthracycline‐Induced Cardiotoxicity Using an Integrated PK/PD Model
pmc-13165276.creator: Mohamed S. Dabour, Anne H. Blaes, Pamala A. Jacobson, Mark N. Kirstein, Beshay N. Zordoky, Shen Cheng
pmc-13165276.description: Doxorubicin (DOX) is an effective chemotherapeutic agent; however, its use is limited by dose‐dependent cardiotoxicity, which is challenging to detect early with current biomarkers such as NT‐proBNP. Growth differentiation factor‐15 (GDF15) has emerged as a promising cytokine associated with cardiovascular disease.

pmc-13312607.title: Galeal scoring for salvage scalp closure following cranioplasty failure: a case report
pmc-13312607.creator: Musawer Khan, Waseem Sajjad, Sajid Khan, Naeem Ul Haq, Shehzad Sadbar
pmc-13312607.description: IntroductionAchieving tension-free scalp closure after decompressive craniectomy or cranioplasty can be quite demanding, especially in patients who have developed fibrosis or infection from previous procedures. In such situations, galeal scoring (galeotomies) can improve scalp mobility. Although this technique is well known in plastic surgery, it is not commonly reported in neurosurgical work.

pmc-13445822.title: Multidrug-resistant Corynebacterium striatum-induced severe pneumonia complicated with multiple organ failure: a diagnostic breakthrough guided by phagocytosis and therapeutic strategy
pmc-13445822.creator: Ruofan Wang, Xiaosong Xu, Zhilong Zheng, Ruiying Li, Xiangsheng Cai
pmc-13445822.description: BackgroundCorynebacterium striatum (C. striatum), a Gram-positive opportunistic pathogen, is increasingly linked to healthcare-associated pneumonia (HAP) in immunocompromised patients, but its nonspecific manifestations and multidrug resistance cause diagnostic delays. This case adds to literature by highlighting neutrophil phagocytosis in sputum smears as a pivotal clue for distinguishing C. striatum infection from contamination, especially in mixed infections.

pmc-13670015.title: The PIEZO1/CISD1/IP3R Mechanotransduction Axis Drives Macrophage Mitochondrial Dysfunction and Inflammatory Activation in Pulmonary Fibrosis
pmc-13670015.creator: Yungeng Wei, Chao Xie, Xiangsheng Yang, Xiao Xiao Tang
pmc-13670015.description: Idiopathic pulmonary fibrosis (IPF) is a progressive and fatal interstitial lung disease characterized by excessive extracellular matrix (ECM) deposition and elevated tissue stiffness. While aberrant mechanotransduction is increasingly recognized as a key driver of fibrotic progression, the mechanisms by which mechanical cues orchestrate macrophage dysfunction remain poorly elucidated.
